typography.family: Noto Sans JP, Yu Gothic UI, Yu Gothic, sans-serif

common.header: slide number only at upper right
common.title: single conclusion headline at upper left
common.titleRule: full-width primary-blue rule directly below title

layoutDefinitions.cover: key message in the upper-middle, learning outcomes as two to four gray bars below
layoutDefinitions.focus: large blue key message on the left, supporting bullets on the right
layoutDefinitions.compare: two equal gray columns with content-specific blue labels and half of the bullets in each column
layoutDefinitions.sequence: three to four horizontal numbered gray steps connected from left to right
layoutDefinitions.evidence: large blue evidence statement on the left, supporting facts on the right
layoutDefinitions.checklist: two-column grid of gray checklist rows with blue checks
layoutDefinitions.action: single blue action statement on the left, numbered next actions on the right

avoid: purple gradient as the main slide treatment
the same layout on three consecutive slides
speaker notes inside the slide canvas
